name: @stackline/png-chunks-extract
description: Dependency-free PNG chunk extraction with bounded validation and CRC checks
author: Stackline maintainers

scripts.lint: eslint index.js index.mjs lib scripts test examples docs-site/*.js docs-site/*.mjs
scripts.test:types: node node_modules/typescript-3-9/bin/tsc -p test/types/tsconfig.legacy.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p test/types/tsconfig.commonjs.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p test/types/tsconfig.modern.json
scripts.test: npm run test:upstream && npm run test:differential && npm run test:malformed && npm run test:fuzz && npm run test:stress && npm run test:browser && npm run test:cjs && npm run test:esm && npm run test:types
scripts.test:coverage: c8 --all --include=index.js --include=lib/crc32.js --check-coverage --lines 95 --functions 95 --branches 85 node --test test/upstream.test.cjs test/differential.test.cjs test/malformed.test.cjs test/fuzz.test.cjs test/stress.test.cjs test/browser.test.cjs test/cjs.test.cjs
scripts.verify: npm run clean && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run docs:prepare && npm run docs:check && npm test && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:closure && npm run check:package && npm run check:licenses && npm run check:sbom && npm run check:release && npm run pack:check && npm run audit:dependencies && npm run audit:all && npm run audit:signatures
